name: Tool Execution Supervision
description: Supervise tool execution: timeouts, resource limits, output capture, error classification.
purpose: Provide safe, bounded tool execution within the scheduler's agent supervision framework.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool execution is bounded by configurable timeouts
Resource limits (memory, CPU, disk) are enforced during tool execution
Tool stdout/stderr/output is captured and returned with the task result
Execution errors are classified into categories (timeout, resource, runtime, system)
Supervision state is observable via monitoring hooks
Failed tool executions propagate error classification to the task failure pipeline
